item.title: Tidy Up History
item.description:
Title: Tidy Up History
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Casual Human
Publisher: Casual Human
Release Date: Sep 16, 2026




About This Game

【Restore Your Museum】

You’ve inherited a once-renowned museum that's now covered in dust and filled with misplaced artifacts. Can you bring it back to life?

【What You'll Do】

Clean and Restore

  • Remove dirt, clutter, and damage from exhibit halls.

  • Bring neglected rooms back to their former glory.

Organize Hundreds of Items

  • Find the rightful place for artifacts, fossils and museum pieces.

  • Turn chaotic collections into beautiful exhibits.

Learn and Unlock new areas

  • Learn about mysterious objects and determine where they belong.

  • Find keys to access locked exhibit rooms.

Assemble Dinosaur Skeletons

  • Collect fossils and piece together impressive prehistoric displays.

  • Complete skeletons part by part.

Level Up Your Skills

  • Earn XP as you restore the museum.

  • Unlock new abilities that help you repair increasingly complex exhibits.

【Prepare for the Grand Opening】

Every room cleaned, artifact identified, and exhibit restored brings the museum one step closer to completion.

Can you transform your unexpected inheritance into the museum of your dreams?

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We are actively working to replace all placeholder AI art before launch. While we aim for a fully human-crafted experience, a few minor assets may still remain at release.

AI tools were also used to assist with localizing the game and store page.

All 3D in-game art was created by human artists or derived from real-world museum photoscans. (See the credits menu for full attributions.)



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel i5-2500 3.3GHz
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: BLACKWOOD
item.description:
Title: BLACKWOOD
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG , Strategy
Developer: AttritoM7 Productions
Publisher: IZilla Games , AttritoM7 Productions
Release Date: Sep 16, 2026




About This Game

Step into the world of BLACKWOOD , a gritty third-person action thriller that blends smooth, responsive combat with cinematic storytelling.

By day, you are a seemingly ordinary store owner, managing your small DVD shop in an authentic recreation of New York, 2012. When night falls, you descend into the city’s underworld as a contract killer, caught between survival, morality, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

One Epic Story Told In Three Parts.

Anton's story takes place over the course of three Acts. Each Act is a complete part of the overall story, with new missions added in between the major acts.

Current Act Roadmap:

  • Act 1: September 16, 2026

  • Act 2: March 2027

  • Act 3: September 2027

When you purchase BLACKWOOD, you are purchasing the full game. All future acts will be provided as free updates to existing owners. If you buy BLACKWOOD at launch, you will not need to purchase Act 2 or Act 3 separately.

Act One Coming September 16, 2026.

FIGHT YOUR WAY THROUGH THE CITY

Gunplay is fast, stylish, and unforgiving. Keep the Action relentless with fluid movement options like dives, rolls, and slides. Every encounter feels cinematic yet responsive, giving you the freedom to create your own moments of chaos.

MASTER BRUTAL TAKEDOWNS

BLACKWOOD’s signature mechanic: countless contextual takedowns. From one-on-one hand-to-hand executions to using the environment around you, every fight is an opportunity to end your enemies with precision and style. Grounded, weighty, and satisfying to master.

A DOUBLE LIFE TO BALANCE

Your store is more than just a front. It's where you live, decorate, and roleplay a “normal” existence. Buy and sell DVDs, change outfits, interact with your apartment, and explore RPG elements that make your dual identity feel tangible. The contrast between day and night defines the world and the choices you make.

CINEMATIC STORYTELLING

BLACKWOOD introduces a cast of flawed, human characters navigating a violent city full of secrets. Every ad, tattoo, and poster tells a story. Every mission pulls you deeper into a web of conspiracies and consequences.

STORE MANAGEMENT

Take control of your DVD shop and decide how hands-on you want to be. Restock shelves, organize inventory, set prices, and jump in at the counter to keep profits high. Let it run on autopilot, and you will get by. Manage it smartly, and you can watch it turn into a powerful source of income

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Blood and Gore
Intense Violence
Strong Language
Use of Drugs and Alcohol



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400F
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 30 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p Low settings, 30 FPS at native resolution. SSD required. FSR2 available as an optional performance mode.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-12400F
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT / Intel Arc A750
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 30 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p High settings, 60 FPS at native resolution. SSD required; NVMe SSD recommended. DLSS/FSR2 available for higher resolutions or additional performance headroom. DirectX 12 is optional on supported hardware for improved PSO stability.

item.title: Another Eden Begins
item.description:
Title: Another Eden Begins
Genre: RPG
Developer: WRIGHT FLYER STUDIOS
Publisher: WRIGHT FLYER STUDIOS
Release Date: Sep 16, 2026




About This Game

Embark on an Adventure Beyond Time and Space

Masato Kato, the creator of numerous RPG classics, presents an epic adventure spanning the past, present, and future! The main story is a richly woven tale with full voice acting, accompanied by a main theme song composed by Yasunori Mitsuda and music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios! Strategic command battles rely on building parties around characters' roles and synergies to unleash additional skills! Use the power of Another Force to execute devastating attacks and edge closer to victory! After completing the main story, another adventure awaits with New Game+! All of the characters retain their strength for this new journey as actions and choices determine which of over 10 endings will unfold!

▽Strategic Command Battles

For command battles you initiate, creating a balanced party of attackers, supporters, and healers is key to victory! Unleash attacks to fill the Another Force gauge, and activate Another Force to stop enemies from taking action while your characters deliver devastating attacks!

▽Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+

Clear the main story to unlock New Game+ and start a new adventure with your characters as they were! With the aid of a mysterious girl who prompts Aldo to undertake this new journey, discover over 10 different endings that unfold based on your actions and choices. A world of new experiences awaits!

▽Encounters and Friendships with 18 Companions

During his adventure across time, Aldo encounters 18 characters with differing backgrounds and talents. Learn more about them through unique encounter quests, character quests, and kinship quests, the last of which becomes available by forging deep connections with them!

▽Story

Aldo and his younger sister, Feinne, enjoy a peaceful life in the idyllic village of Baruoki, until one day, when Feinne is taken by the Beast King. Aldo pursues them into the Moonlight Forest, but following a fierce battle with a beast, he is sent through a tear in spacetime—and finds himself in a world 800 years in the future.

item.title: Woodo
item.description:
Title: Woodo
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: Tiny Monks Tales
Publisher: Daedalic Entertainment
Release Date: Sep 16, 2026




About This Game



Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.




Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.




With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.


The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.




  • Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
  • The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
  • Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
  • Simple but deeply meaningful story
  • The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
  • Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
  • Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile

item.description:
Title: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
Genre: Action , Adventure
Developer: Joeveno
Publisher: Joeveno , NoQuarter
Release Date: Sep 16, 2026




About This Game

"BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO IS THE BEST BOOMER SHOOTER OF 2026"

-Civvie11

"A weird stress ball that your hand feels slimy after touching"

-Civvie11

BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4 is a fast-paced BRAZILIAN old school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, and using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). It is a standalone expansion of the hit boomer shooter BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT ! And It is A TRIBUTE TO THE BRAZILIAN MODS OF THE 2000S, THE BRAZILIAN BOOTLEG GAMES OF THE 2000S, BRAZILIAN MUSIC AND THE BEST BAND IN THE HISTORY OF BRAZIL, MAMADAS!

AFTER YOU SAVE MIT AIA, MACKIE JACKIE AND THE MAMADAS, YOU DO A PARTY IN HEAVEN! BUT THINGS TOOK A BAD TURN WHEN THE MAMADAS WERE KIDNAPPNED BY RONALDO MCDALEST! SAVE THEM FROM RONALDO, AND SAVE THEIR GLOBECETA PORTAL OPENER CAR TOO! RONALDO STILL HAS SOME DEMONS FROM THE INVASION AROUND! END THE REMAINING DEMONS AND SAVE RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO AND SALVADOR!

  • Use your quake-ish movement abilities to stay mobile and avoid the relentless attacks of the dead, demons and other BRAZILIAN POSSESSED.

  • DO A DASH AND A DOUBLE JUMP NOW CUZ YOU INSERTED FIREWORKS UP YOUR HOLE!!

  • CRAZY WEAPONS LIKE BERIMBAU, PAYPHONE THAT SHOOTS COCONUTS AND MONEY PAPER AIRPLANE GUN RETURN!! ALSO NEW ONES COME TO THE ROSTER, LIKE THE FEIJOADA (BEAN) BOWL WITH A SLINGSHOT, AND THE CHIMARRÃO DRINK FLAMETHROWER!!

  • A BUNCH OF ENEMIES GOING FROM ARMED DEMONS TO ZOMBIES, BRAZILIAN TRUCK CLOWNS AND EVEN POSSESSED BRAZILIAN SINGERS! ALSO NEW ENEMIES LIKE TWO DUDES IN A MOTORCYCLE, ANGRY TV MOUSES, AND POSSESSED SOCCER TEAM MASCOTS!

  • 18 CAMPAIGN STAGES GOING THROUGH THE ENTIRE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, PARTS OF SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE RIO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR AND SAVE THE MAMADAS!

  • 7 HORDE MAPS IN THE HORDE MODE CALLED MORE COMING! (THE MORE COMING MODE IS BACK! BE CAREFUL WITH THE ZOMBIE HORDE AS THERE'S MORE COMING UP TO YA!!)

  • LOTS OF SECRET AREAS ON EACH LEVEL!

  • EAT PASTEL AND DRINK CANE BROTH TO GAIN HEALTH! IT'S SCATTERED ON THE MAPS!

  • COOPERATIVE ON ALL CAMPAIGN MAPS!

  • 6 DEATHMATCH FOCUSED MAPS!

  • EASY MULTIPLAYER THROUGH STEAMWORKS! JOIN FRIENDS BY INVITING THEM! NO PORT FORWARD NEEDED! (Its a beta test tho, its super duper unstable right now.)

  • REPLAY THE GAME WITH ROCKET JUMPING OR DOUBLE JUMP IN MIND TO FIND EXCLUSIVE ROCKET JUMP AND DOUBLE JUMP SECRET AREAS! OLD SCHOOL 90S STYLE!

  • ATTENTION : THE GAME WILL STILL RECEIVE CONTENT MONTHLY JUST LIKE BDD3!

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Game features pixelated blood and gore. Enemies will bleed when shot and can explode into cartoonish gibs if enough damage is done.

    • Processor: Intel Core i3 3110M
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM

    • DirectX: Version 11
